pay_tips_content:
* Paid content can be unlocked through coin purchases or subscriptions.
* Coins do not expire and are non-refundable once used.
* Recharge may be delayed. If you do not receive it within 1 hour, please contact customer service.
* Subscription Service: During your subscription period, you can watch all paid content for free.
* Subscription Plans: You can change your subscription plan at any time, but the changes will take effect after the current billing cycle ends.
* Subscription Renewal: Your subscription will automatically renew at the end of the current billing cycle.
* Subscription Cancellation: You can cancel your subscription in the Google Play store at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing cycle.
* Manage Subscriptions: You can manage and cancel your subscriptions in 'Google Play > Profile > Payments & Subscriptions'.

delete_account_tip:
Dear user, your account deletion request will be processed 1 day after submission. Once processed, the account deletion will be carried out 30 days later. During this 30-day period, if you log in and continue using our services, the deletion request will be automatically canceled.
We recommend that you log in during this period to confirm or cancel the deletion request. If you have any questions or need further assistance, please contact our customer support team.
Thank you for your support and trust in our services!
